question: Select the synonym of **Foster.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Promote**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Foster"** means to encourage the development or growth of something, often by providing care and support. (प्रोत्साहित करना, पालन-पोषण करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher worked hard to foster creativity in her students.
 
 
 
• **"Promote"** refers to actively supporting or encouraging something to flourish or progress. (बढ़ावा देना)
 
 
• **Example:** She was promoted to a managerial position because of her exceptional performance.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **"Foster"** is **"Promote"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Promote**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Neglect** (उपेक्षा करना): To fail to take care of or give proper attention to something or someone.

 
 
• **Example:** The gardener neglected the plants, and many of them withered away.
 
 
 
• **Reject** (अस्वीकार करना): To refuse to accept, consider, or use something.
 
 
• **Example:** The editor rejected the manuscript because it lacked originality.
 
 
 
• **Oppose** (विरोध करना): To actively resist or challenge something.
 
 
• **Example:** The citizens opposed the construction of the factory due to environmental concerns.
 
 

78:Tb94,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
